chunks: That is so for God is the undeniable Reality. It is He who brings the dead to life, for He has power over everything.

key_terms.يُحْيِي: He gives life / He brings to life

ai.seo_question: Why does God affirm His power over everything in relation to resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as the foundational 'illah' (reason) for the preceding command to follow the truth, affirming that God's nature as Al-Haqq (The Ultimate Reality) guarantees the certainty of resurrection. It highlights the theological link between divine omnipotence and the inevitability of the Hereafter, a core tenet in Shia eschatology.
